Implement proper authentication and remove the shared static admin token
Run containers as non-root and disable root access
Update Flask to a supported version and migrate to a maintained framework if needed
Ensure the database security group only allows inbound traffic from the EKS cluster
Enable EBS encryption and use AWS IMDSv2 for instance metadata
Migrate data from SQLite to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL
Store reports in an S3 bucket instead of the local filesystem
Replace the Flask development server with a production-ready server (e.g., Gunicorn)
Implement automated backups for the RDS database
Use environment variables for configuration instead of hard-coding
Send logs to stdout in JSON format
Use Kubernetes jobs for scheduled tasks instead of host cron
Right-size the instance to meet performance requirements without over-provisioning

# Migration spec: inventory-service

## Summary

- Replatform legacy-inventory Flask app to Amazon EKS as an independently deployable microservice.
- Target region **us-west-2** with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL (multi-AZ) and Graviton (arm64) instances.
- Size for **40 requests/second** peak load with **2 replicas (min)**, autoscaling up to **6 replicas**.
- Monthly budget **USD 450**; 99.9% availability SLO, RPO 15 minutes, RTO 1 hour.

## Key decisions

| Decision | Value | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Platform | Amazon EKS | G1 |
| Region | us-west-2 | TC1 |
| Database | Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL (multi-AZ) | TC3, G2 |
| CPU architecture | arm64 (Graviton) | TC2 |
| Replicas minimum | 2 | NFR3 |
| Autoscaling metric | CPU | NFR3 |
| Budget | USD 450/month | G3 |
| Logging | JSON to stdout | NFR5 |
| Secrets management | AWS Secrets Manager | SEC1 |

## Risks

- Cost may exceed budget if traffic grows before scaling headroom is used.
- Graviton compatibility needs verification; may require application changes.
- Data migration window and strategy still to be confirmed; risk of extended downtime.

<!-- generated: tables rendered from the validated spec -->

## Target specification

| Area | Values |
|---|---|
| Target | eks in us-west-2, Kubernetes 1.33, arm64, IaC terraform, registry ecr |
| Workload | port 8080, probes /healthz and /readyz, replicas 2-6 on cpu 70%, peak 40 rps, p95 300 ms |
| Data | postgres 16 on rds, Multi-AZ yes, migrate from sqlite |
| NFR | SLO 99.9%, RPO 15 min, RTO 60 min, logging json-stdout |
| Security | secrets aws-secrets-manager, encryption at rest yes, private DB yes, non-root yes, read-only root FS yes |
| FinOps | USD 450/month (prod), prefer Graviton yes, growth x3 next year |
